components.css: .ds-project{padding:23px;border:1px solid hsl(var(--border,220 10% 82%));border-radius:16px;background:hsl(var(--card,0 0% 100%));color:hsl(var(--foreground,225 16% 12%));max-width:410px}.ds-project h3{font:500 25px Sora,sans-serif;margin:8px 0 10px}.ds-project h3 a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-project h3 a:hover{color:hsl(var(--primary,223 73% 45%))}.ds-project p{font:14px/1.75 Inter,sans-serif;color:hsl(var(--muted-foreground,220 9% 40%));margin:0}.ds-project p:first-child{font-size:12px}.ds-project a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid hsl(var(--primary,223 73% 45%));outline-offset:5px}

narrative.overview: Real project interfaces carry the visual evidence, with a personal portrait giving the work a human anchor. This revision records Kevin's requested three-card fan, folder archive, and separate light/dark portraits. It remains a local preview for his manual design critique.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light and charcoal dark surfaces
Three homepage projects and four project folders
Compact mobile identity and content-sized fanned cards
Desktop folder tabs become a mobile accordion
dos: Preserve every route and its content.
Use accurate product status and attribution.
donts: Do not publish without a later user request.
Do not invent product metrics or release claims.
